# hyperfluid_agent_matrix_channel (Resource)

The Matrix channel of an agent, Tchap included (`preset = "tchap"`): the bot is an ordinary account that logs in once, keeps its device and reads encrypted rooms. Creating it sets the channel and lists `matrix` in the agent's interfaces; destroying it removes both, and the agent stays. The generic preset needs `allowed_rooms` or `allowed_users`. Every change sends the whole channel configuration again: an argument removed from the configuration returns to the platform's default. A channel removed outside Terraform leaves the state, and the next apply sets it again. The status attributes (`phase`, `identity`, `message`, `last_event_at`) are the gateway's and are refreshed on read without planning changes. The platform refuses a channel on a capability, and on an agent whose tools include general `hfctl` unless the agent sets `allow_platform_tools`. Imported by agent id. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The bot account's password and recovery key, stored once as plaintext
# secrets (for instance with `hfctl secrets create plaintext`). Terraform only
# references them by id.
data "hyperfluid_secret" "bot_password" {
  name = "tchap-bot-password"
}

data "hyperfluid_secret" "bot_recovery_key" {
  name = "tchap-bot-recovery-key"
}

resource "hyperfluid_agent_matrix_channel" "this" {
  agent_id = hyperfluid_agent.support.id
  preset   = "tchap"
  user_id  = "@bot-support:example.org"

  password_secret_id     = data.hyperfluid_secret.bot_password.id
  recovery_key_secret_id = data.hyperfluid_secret.bot_recovery_key.id

  allowed_users   = ["@*:example.org"]
  direct_messages = true

  # Change to a new value when `relogin_required` is true.
  relogin_trigger = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`. Changing this forces a new Matrix channel.
- `password_secret_id` (String) The bot account's password, used only to create its device. The id of a plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` of the organization: the value is never sent or stored by Terraform.
- `recovery_key_secret_id` (String) The account's recovery key (shown when its encryption was set up), to verify the bot's device. The id of a plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` of the organization: the value is never sent or stored by Terraform.
- `user_id` (String) The bot's Matrix user id, `@name:server`. The bot logs in with it, never with an email address.

### Optional

- `allow_external_inference` (Boolean) With the `tchap` preset, accept a model that is not served in the cluster: decrypted messages then leave it. Flagged in the console.
- `allowed_rooms` (Set of String) Room ids (`!…:server`) the bot answers in.
- `allowed_users` (Set of String) User ids the bot answers, globs allowed (`@*:server`). Required for `direct_messages`.
- `auto_join` (String) Which invitations the bot accepts: `allowlisted` (the platform's default), `invited` or `never`.
- `direct_messages` (Boolean) Whether the bot answers direct messages from `allowed_users`.
- `extra_auth_hosts` (Set of String) More hosts the login may need to reach, such as an authentication service on its own host.
- `homeserver_url` (String) The homeserver's client API URL, `https://…`. Required with the `generic` preset.
- `preset` (String) `tchap` or `generic` (left out). `tchap` fills the homeserver's authentication hosts, and refuses an agent whose model is not served in the cluster unless `allow_external_inference` is set.
- `relogin_trigger` (String) Any value; changing it to a new value asks for one more login of the bot (the operator mounts the password and recovery key until the bot is back). Needed when `relogin_required` is true. Removing it, or setting it at creation, does not log in again. Terraform-only: the platform does not store it. Refused (409) before the bot's first device.
- `unencrypted_rooms` (String) Whether the bot answers in unencrypted rooms: `never`, `allowlisted` (the platform's default) or `any`.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the channel is active: its configuration is present and its interface listed on the agent.
- `device_id` (String) The bot's Matrix device, once it has logged in.
- `id` (String) The agent id.
- `identity` (String) Who the bot is on the network, as the gateway reports it.
- `last_event_at` (String) When the gateway last saw an event, RFC 3339.
- `message` (String) The gateway's detail on the current phase.
- `phase` (String) The gateway's phase for this channel: `Connecting`, `Connected`, `NeedsLogin`, `Degraded` or `Disabled`. Empty until the operator has reported it. Refreshed on read, it never plans a change on its own.
- `relogin_pending` (Boolean) A re-login was requested and the bot has not reconnected since.
- `relogin_required` (Boolean) The bot's session ended after its first device: change `relogin_trigger` to log it in again.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the agent id (uuid).
# relogin_trigger is not recovered.
terraform import hyperfluid_agent_matrix_channel.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
